text.text:
Great beef noodles in this lovely corner. The owner wants to replicate her fathers’ taste and this store is the result. The soup was cooked with beef bones for 9 hours; it’s favorable and surprisingly the soup gets even tastier when it’s less hot.

The side dishes are tasty and delicate. Another must try is the shrimp dumplings with sesame flavored hand-made sauce. The owner is hospitable. The place is warm and welcoming. It’s one of a kind dining experience in WanHua. Highly recommended.

text.text: An excellent beef noodle - tender beef and superb soup, not thickened, just an edge of vinegar and a deep umami base…. The owner makes it all based on her dad’s recipe…. And she likes to chat! Great value and also very elegant, with a Japanese vibe - my top noodle shop!

text.text:
Small restaurant, maybe it's hard to find but it's worth if you visit the temple and walk 10min over.

You have to order at the vendor outside, and bring the receipt inside.

The owner really nice, the beef noodle soup is excellent, it's the soy base soup and very well balanced.

Recommend.

text.text:
Delicious food and a lovely owner.
The beef noodle soup is exquisite, with beef that is incredibly tender and melts in your mouth. The broth is rich, deep, and full of flavour.

The owner is exceptionally friendly and welcoming. During my short trip to Taipei, I visited this restaurant twice, and on both occasions I was greeted with a warm smile and even offered complimentary items to accompany my meal.

I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting Taipei.

text.text: The beef noodle soup here is excellent! The beef is incredibly tender, and the broth is light yet full of flavor — not oily or heavy at all. I really like that after finishing the whole bowl, you don’t feel greasy or thirsty like with some other places. Definitely one of the best, most balanced beef noodle soups I’ve had!
